scaryLine1: Police, CBI and customs never question anyone on a video call.
scaryLine2: Nobody can arrest you on the phone. Do not send any money.
scaryLine3: Hang up now and call your family.
scaryWaMessage: I got a scary call from someone saying they are police or CBI. I have cut the call and I have not paid. Please call me now.
saathiIntro: Practice only: play this made-up scam call to your parent, then repeat the three rules together.
saathiNoAudio: Audio not recorded yet for this language. Read the script aloud instead.
saathiTranscript: Hello, this is Inspector Vijay from the CBI cyber cell, Mumbai. A parcel in your name with illegal drugs was seized. An arrest warrant has been issued. Stay on this video call and do not tell anyone in your family. To prove you are innocent, transfer your savings to the RBI verification account now.
saathiRule1: Police never question anyone on a video call.
saathiRule2: No officer asks you to stay on a call to "stay safe", or to move money.
saathiRule3: Hang up, and call your family.
heroTitle: Lost money to a scam? Act in the first hour.
heroSub: Report to the 1930 helpline with every detail ready, check suspicious messages privately, and prepare your cybercrime.gov.in complaint, in English, Hindi or Tamil.
how1Body: India's cyber fraud helpline. Reporting quickly improves the chance that the money can be held.
how2Body: Type them in, or let AWS Textract read your payment screenshot. You check every field against the image.
how3Body: A 1930 call script, cybercrime.gov.in fields and a bank email, all built from the same confirmed details.
trust1: Messages are checked on your device
trust2: Screenshots are read once and never stored
saathiCardSub: Play a practice scam call for a parent, then learn three simple rules together.
